drhp.business: HP Adhesives Limited manufactures adhesives, sealants and related bonding products for domestic and export markets, with manufacturing centred at its facility in Khalapur Taluka, Raigad district, Maharashtra. It serves varied applications across consumer and industrial segments through an established product portfolio and a multi-channel market presence spanning distributors, dealers, OEM customers and export markets.

drhp.expansion: The Company's manufacturing strategy for FY 2025-26 centred on restoring Unit I following the January 2026 fire, alongside its historical approach of capacity enhancement through plant and equipment additions, process improvements and better utilisation of available infrastructure. Standby arrangements at adjoining facilities were activated post-fire, with Unit II production capacity re-purposed to accommodate solvent cement production and packaging lines to support customer supply, alongside outsourced production to select vendors.

risks.note: Shifts in the geopolitical and macroeconomic landscape can disrupt regular operations and affect financial stability.
Dependence on suppliers for raw materials, packaging materials and capex components leaves the Company vulnerable to disruptions in production and delivery.
Product quality is critical to the Company's reputation and any lapse could lead to customer dissatisfaction and brand damage.
Over-dependence on a single product category could leave the Company vulnerable to competition or obsolescence.
Heavy reliance on a few key customers could expose the Company to client attrition or defaults, though the Company states a broad base of 1,750 customers as on 31st March, 2026.
Intense competition from domestic and global players could affect the Company's market share and pricing power.
Non-compliance with applicable laws and regulations could lead to penalties and reputational harm.

A fire at the Company's Unit I facility on 17th January, 2026 halted solvent cement production and reduced operating margins as sales were lost; final insurance settlement remains outstanding as at year-end.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- distribution: broad multi-channel domestic and export network — evidence: more than 1,625 distributors across 30 states and UTs reaching more than 450 cities, plus 49 export customers across 22 countries as at 31st March, 2026
- customer lock-in: single-source supplier positioning for plumbing/construction fittings — evidence: ball valves, PTFE tape and masking tape sold as complementary products alongside the core solvent cement range to reinforce positioning as a single-source supplier for plumbing, construction, repair and finishing requirements
